manifest.title: 职场吐槽
manifest.description: 加班、开会、KPI 与无效对齐：职场英语短句

items.text: Another meeting that could have been an email.
items.hint: 又是一场本可以发邮件的会议。

items.text: My calendar is a wall of back-to-back calls.
items.hint: 我的日程被一场接一场的会堵死了。

items.text: The deadline moved up, but the scope did not shrink.
items.hint: 截止日期提前了，范围却一点没缩。

items.text: I fixed the bug, then someone renamed the file.
items.hint: 我修好了 bug，然后有人把文件改名了。

items.text: Please stop tagging me on every Slack thread.
items.hint: 别再每个 Slack 线程都 @ 我了。

items.text: We pivoted again before lunch.
items.hint: 午饭前我们又转向了一次。

items.text: My standup update is longer than the stand-up.
items.hint: 我的站会更新比站会本身还长。

items.text: The KPI looks green until you open the sheet.
items.hint: KPI 看着是绿的，直到你打开表格。

items.text: I am not anti-process; I am anti-busywork.
items.hint: 我不是反对流程，我是反对无效忙碌。

items.text: Can we decide something without another workshop?
items.hint: 我们能不能不开工作坊就做个决定？

items.text: The slide deck has thirty pages and one idea.
items.hint: 这份 PPT 三十页，却只有一个观点。

items.text: I already answered that in the last message.
items.hint: 我上一条消息已经回答过了。

items.text: Remote work is fine until every chat becomes urgent.
items.hint: 远程挺好的，直到每条聊天都变紧急。

items.text: My manager wants ownership without authority.
items.hint: 老板要我背锅，却不给我权限。

items.text: The ticket says easy; the code says otherwise.
items.hint: 工单写着简单，代码不这么认为。

items.text: We shipped Friday and spent Monday on hotfixes.
items.hint: 周五上线，周一全在修线上。

items.text: I muted the channel and nothing exploded.
items.hint: 我静音了那个频道，世界也没塌。

items.text: Please read the doc before asking the same question.
items.hint: 提问前请先把文档读完。

items.text: The roadmap is a wishlist with dates.
items.hint: 所谓路线图，就是带日期的许愿清单。

items.text: I am offline for focus time, not for drama.
items.hint: 我离线是为了专注，不是为了演戏。

items.text: Another all-hands with no room for questions.
items.hint: 又一场不给人提问时间的全员会。

items.text: The feedback is vague, but the rating is low.
items.hint: 反馈很模糊，评分却很低。

items.text: We optimized for optics, not outcomes.
items.hint: 我们优化的是观感，不是结果。

items.text: My to-do list grows faster than my paycheck.
items.hint: 待办增长比工资快。

items.text: I CC everyone so nobody can claim they never saw it.
items.hint: 我抄送所有人，省得有人说没看见。

items.text: The design is approved until the demo.
items.hint: 设计已经过了，直到演示那天。

items.text: Please stop moving my deadlines in the chat.
items.hint: 别在聊天里偷偷改我的截止日期。

items.text: We need alignment, which means three more meetings.
items.hint: 需要对齐，也就是再说开三场会。

items.text: I documented it twice; people still ask me live.
items.hint: 我写了两遍文档，大家还是当面来问。

items.text: The urgency is fake; the overtime is real.
items.hint: 紧急是假的，加班是真的。

items.text: My laptop battery dies before the last call ends.
items.hint: 最后一场会还没完，电脑电先没了。

items.text: We hired a consultant to tell us what we knew.
items.hint: 我们请了顾问，告诉我们已知的事。

items.text: The shared drive is a museum of old versions.
items.hint: 共享盘是旧版本博物馆。

items.text: I prefer clear no over soft maybe.
items.hint: 我宁愿要明确的不，也不要软绵绵的也许。

items.text: The sprint goal changed mid-sprint. Again.
items.hint: 冲刺目标在半途又改了。又一次。

items.text: My calendar invite has no agenda and twelve people.
items.hint: 会议邀请没有议程，却有十二个人。

items.text: We celebrate busyness like it is a skill.
items.hint: 我们把忙碌当作成就来庆祝。

items.text: I archived the thread; the problem remained.
items.hint: 我归档了线程，问题还在。

items.text: Please ping with context, not just hey.
items.hint: 麻烦带上背景再 ping，别只发个 hey。

items.text: The promotion cycle is a mystery novel.
items.hint: 晋升周期像一本悬疑小说。

items.text: I reused last quarter slides with new dates.
items.hint: 我把上季度的幻灯片换了日期继续用。

items.text: The blocker is waiting on someone who is on leave.
items.hint: 卡点在等一个请假的人。

items.text: We measure everything except what matters.
items.hint: 我们什么都量，除了真正重要的。

items.text: My headphones are the only office perk I trust.
items.hint: 耳机是我唯一信得过的办公福利。

items.text: The policy PDF is longer than the product.
items.hint: 政策 PDF 比产品本身还长。

items.text: I said no, and somehow it became a follow-up.
items.hint: 我说了不，结果变成了跟进事项。

items.text: The quiet hours end when leadership types.
items.hint: 领导一打字，静音时段就结束了。

items.text: We need headcount, not another brainstorm.
items.hint: 我们需要人手，不是又一场头脑风暴。

items.text: My best work happens between cancelled meetings.
items.hint: 我最好的工作，发生在被取消的会议之间。

items.text: Please stop calling everything a quick sync.
items.hint: 别什么都叫「快速同步」了。

items.text: The OKR is ambitious; the resources are not.
items.hint: OKR 很雄心，资源却跟不上。

items.text: I fixed production with a one-line change and a long night.
items.hint: 一行改动修好了生产，却耗掉一整夜。

items.text: The office snacks improved; the priorities did not.
items.hint: 零食变好了，优先级没有。

items.text: We talk about culture when retention drops.
items.hint: 留存一掉，我们就开始谈文化。

items.text: My status is busy, which somehow means available.
items.hint: 状态显示忙碌，大家却当我在线。

items.text: The launch date is firm until it is not.
items.hint: 上线日期很确定，直到它不确定。

items.text: I prefer async updates over performative presence.
items.hint: 我更喜欢异步更新，而不是表演式在线。

items.text: The ticket bounced between three teams and landed on me.
items.hint: 工单在三个团队间弹来弹去，最后落到我。

items.text: We need fewer tools and clearer owners.
items.hint: 我们需要更少工具、更清晰的负责人。

items.text: End of day, and my inbox still thinks it is morning.
items.hint: 一天结束了，收件箱还以为是早上。
